name: ユーザー作成・招待を始める一覧ヘッダー操作群
prompt: Recreate only the supplied 204 x 43 px Snowflake user-management header action group as a crisp Japanese UI component. Keep the exact shallow horizontal layout and pale near-white background. On the left, render one muted blue-gray text action, 「ユーザーを作成」, vertically centered, in a clean Japanese sans-serif at about 14 px and medium weight. On the right, retain a single saturated blue primary button with the exact Japanese label 「招待」 in white semibold text; button bounds are x=124..203 and y=1..42 in the 204 x 43 canvas, with an 8 px corner radius. Center the button label. Keep a generous 18 px gap between the left action and button, align both actions to the source's vertical center, and preserve the compact source proportions. No icons, borders around the text action, shadows, extra labels, page content, or added padding. The final deliverable should contain only this one action group, with no surrounding canvas visible.
reviewNotes: 日本語の作成・招待アクションとして判読可能。目視および原寸計測でボタンはx=127..202,y=1..41。原図x=124..203,y=2..42に比べ左端が3px右、幅が4px狭く、青もやや鮮明。第2版で位置幅を調整。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。

references.acquisitionRoute: Mobbin search_screens の image_url を PowerShell Invoke-WebRequest で直接取得し、原画面WebPとして保存
